lines.zh: 我拖着长长的身体往前挪。
lines.en: I drag my long body forward.

lines.zh: 我的手臂伸出去，先探到墙。
lines.en: My arm reaches out and finds the wall first.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，每步都跨得很长。
lines.en: Step by step, and each stride is long.

lines.zh: 我的身体在阴影里折了两次。
lines.en: My body folds twice in the shadow.
I stretch on down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灯暗下去。
lines.en: The lamps dim where I pass.

lines.zh: 我的手臂先到了，身体还在后面。
lines.en: My arm arrives first. The body is still behind.
I squeeze under the doorframe.
I walk and reach as I go.

lines.zh: 我停下来，居然后退了半格。
lines.en: I stop and draw back half a block.

lines.zh: 我抬高一只手臂，够到了横梁。
lines.en: I raise an arm and touch the beam.
I unfold slowly in the dark.

lines.zh: 我站着，手臂已经伸出很远。
lines.en: I stand with an arm stretched far ahead.

lines.zh: 指节一节节伸长，又缩回。
lines.en: My knuckles stretch out, joint by joint.
My body is longer than the hall.
The wall is at my hand. I lean on it.
There is a sound at the far end.
Slowly I draw my fingers back.

lines.zh: 我的关节像是多出来一节。
lines.en: My joints feel as if they have an extra link.
I am listening to my own beat.
The lamp flickered twice and held.

lines.zh: 我把头侧过去，贴在墙上。
lines.en: I put my head against the wall.
The air here clings.

lines.zh: 我伸出去的手，停在半空。
lines.en: My outstretched hand hangs in the air.

lines.zh: 手臂垂着，指尖还在抽动。
lines.en: My arms hang, fingertips still twitching.
I stretch my shadow longer.

lines.zh: 墙角不够远，我的手指还在伸。
lines.en: The corner isn't far enough; my fingers keep stretching.
My hand has not touched you yet.

lines.zh: 你看得见我的身体，看不见尽头。
lines.en: You can see my body and not its end.

lines.zh: 你走的那条路，我伸长就能到。
lines.en: I can reach the way you came by stretching.

lines.zh: 你不用抬头，我就在这一层。
lines.en: No need to look up. I am on your level.
My fingers are taller than you.
I have been reaching and waiting.
I touched your shadow first.
You should not have come into this hall.
There is no lamp along this stretch.
Slowly I lower my hand.

lines.zh: 我的身体在你身后也有。
lines.en: Part of my body is behind you too.
Turning takes you time.
No hurry. I am long.
Watch the hand. Not elsewhere.
My arm is longer than the hallway.
At this distance I need not walk.

lines.zh: 五指撑开，够到你的肩膀。
lines.en: Five fingers spread and reach your shoulder.
If you back away, I am there too.
Do you hear the beat?
One of my joints has been knocked aside.
I draw back a little.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的手臂上。
lines.en: That struck my arm.
A little blood runs along the floor.
My hand is still stretched out.

lines.zh: 抓取的手一顿，我转头看你。
lines.en: My grabbing hand pauses; I turn my head.

lines.zh: 我伸出的手臂缩回一截。
lines.en: My outstretched arm retracts a length.
My joints clicked twice.
I fold myself tighter.
The beat slipped one bar.
I need not reach for that.

lines.zh: 它在我指头间响了一下。
lines.en: It made a sound between my fingers.
I pinch it up and look.
It cracked. A short sound.
That sound is off key.
I throw it down the hall.
I stretched over and touched it.
Too soft. No interest.
I draw my fingers back empty.

lines.zh: 那点东西，不值得我弯腰。
lines.en: That is not worth bending for.
You hit one of my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我的一节身体在你脚边。
lines.en: One of my joints is at your feet.
I gave two blocks and am still ahead.
What you stepped on was not the floor.
Slowly I reach an arm around.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我连头都没转。
lines.en: I did not even turn my head.

lines.zh: 你退了，我的手臂还伸着。
lines.en: You moved back and my arm stays out.

lines.zh: 这条走廊太窄，我们都不好受。
lines.en: The hall is too narrow for both of us.
I turn my body sideways.
You struck me and I lost a beat.
I am alone in this corridor.

lines.zh: 我伸得再远，也碰不到别人。
lines.en: However far I reach, I touch no one.

lines.zh: 很长的一段，就我一个人唱。
lines.en: A very long stretch, and one voice singing.
Both ends of the wall lead nowhere.

lines.zh: 我的手一直伸着，习惯了。
lines.en: My hand stays out. I am used to it.

lines.zh: 有时候我觉得后面还有人。
lines.en: Sometimes I think there is someone behind me.

lines.zh: 那只是我身上的一节动了。
lines.en: It is only a segment of me shifting.

lines.zh: 我把身体折起来，占的地方小。
lines.en: I fold myself to take less room.
That counts as company, in a way.
This passage will still finish.

lines.zh: 我伸出去的手摸到了一个东西。
lines.en: My outstretched hand found something.
I hold it between finger tips.
It slipped through my fingers.
I need not bend. I simply reach.

lines.zh: 指尖捏着它，像捏一粒沙。
lines.en: My fingertips hold it like a grain of sand.
What is too far, I cannot reach.
I dropped it on the floor.
I cannot make it out, so I put it down.
My hand is still out and empty.
I want none of it.
Footsteps at the end of the hall.
I reach out first.

lines.zh: 这个距离对我来说很近。
lines.en: That is close for me.
I drag myself forward half a block.
It still cannot find where I am.

lines.zh: 我这条身体沿着墙排开。
lines.en: My body is laid out along the wall.
It is coming this way.
I spread my fingers.

lines.zh: 我的手已经在你那一段了。
lines.en: My hand is already in that stretch.

lines.zh: 它一停，我的手指就够到了。
lines.en: It stops, and my fingers reach it.
It keeps looking at that wall.
I am the part in the wall.
It lifted a hand. Perfect.
I start drawing myself in.
In this stretch I need not chase.
It has walked in on its own.
My hand stays ahead of it.
Each step it takes, I draw back a block.
It thinks the hall is empty.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，贴着地面。
lines.en: I lower my head to the floor.
It stopped in the middle.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手从后面绕。
lines.en: My other hand comes round behind.
It turns its head this way.
Slowly I draw my fingers together.
It did not move. Neither did I.
The lamp shadow swung.

lines.zh: 这段伸出来的手，抓得很远。
lines.en: This reaching hand grabs from far off.

lines.zh: 我的身体已经围住它两边。
lines.en: My body already walls it on both sides.

lines.zh: 我拖着长身体往前，绕过那道墙。
lines.en: I drag my long body forward, around the wall.

lines.zh: 跑也没用，走廊就这么长。
lines.en: Running will not help. The hall is only so long.
I open my palm.
It runs into my hand.
I lower a little from above.
It looks upward.
The stretch I am in is very dark.
It keeps walking this way.
My fingers close.
It is held entirely in my grip.
I hold it up to the lamp.
It struggles in my hand.
I draw my arm back.
Its feet kick at the air.
My hand reaches very far.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，伸出的手还没收。
lines.en: A bone cracked; the reaching hand has not withdrawn.
I press it to the wall.
Its hands claw my fingers.

lines.zh: 我的另一只手也过来了。
lines.en: My other hand arrives.
This passage has slowed.
It has stopped. I draw my hand back.
I reach out, and my arm keeps reaching.
I draw my arm back in.
I keep singing.
I stretch out from the end of the hall.

lines.zh: 我的手臂先到，身体还在后面。
lines.en: My arm arrives first; the body follows.
This floor is narrower than I thought.

lines.zh: 我的身体在门框上折过去。
lines.en: My body folds over the doorframe.
The lamp goes out as I pass.

lines.zh: 我把手指贴在墙上，试着距离。
lines.en: I lay my fingers on the wall to judge it.
The echo runs long here.
Slowly I unfold myself.
The floor answers under me.
I look down this end of the hall.

lines.zh: 我的影子铺满了半条走廊。
lines.en: My shadow fills half the corridor.
The beat begins here.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经碰到了对面的墙。
lines.en: My fingers already touch the far wall.
There is no one else on this floor.

lines.zh: 我把身体贴着地上的影子。
lines.en: I lay my body along the shadow on the floor.

lines.zh: 墙角有一片没光的地方。
lines.en: There is an unlit patch in the corner.
I heard it first, then reached.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸让灰尘动了一下。
lines.en: My breath stirs the dust.
I draw myself out very long.
This hall has two doors.

lines.zh: 火光把走廊照亮了，我缩进暗处。
lines.en: The fire lit the hall and I shrank into the dark.

lines.zh: 天花板塌了，我跟着落下。
lines.en: The ceiling gave and I came down with it.
Water fills the length of me.
The blast threw me against the far wall.

lines.zh: 我伸出去的手，比你想象的长。
lines.en: My reaching hand is longer than you think.

lines.zh: 怪光顺着我的手臂爬上来。
lines.en: Strange light crawls up my arm.

lines.zh: 我伸了很久，什么也没碰到。
lines.en: I have reached a long while and touched nothing.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的身体走了一遍，我伸得更长。
lines.en: Lightning runs through my body and I stretch farther.

lines.zh: 走廊的地板没了，我在坠落。
lines.en: The hall floor is gone and I am falling.
